text:
Copper wire is available in fixed lengths but in various diameters d. Each wire has a different
resistance R.
Which relationship between R and d is correct?
A
R is directly proportional to d.
R is directly proportional to d2.
B
C
R is inversely proportional to d.
R is inversely proportional to d2.
D

options.label: A
options.text: R is directly proportional to d.

options.label: B
options.text: R is directly proportional to d2.

options.label: C
options.text: R is inversely proportional to d.

options.label: D
options.text: R is inversely proportional to d2.
